findings.problem: Subject still guarantees the full bond back ('Get your full bond back, guaranteed'). Breaks voice.md section 4 and emails.md.
findings.fix: Use a calm subject with no outcome promise, e.g. 'Get ready for your move-out'.

findings.problem: Preview still says 'you can't lose' (result promise) and 'Only 3 left!' (fake scarcity for a digital product).
findings.fix: Replace with a factual preview, e.g. 'A simple plan to help you prepare for move-out.'

findings.problem: 'Only 3 toolkits left! Buy now before they're gone.' is fake urgency and scarcity.
findings.fix: Delete the line. Mention a deadline only if it is real (LAUNCH10 ends after the first 2 weeks).

findings.problem: Reads as legal advice: tells the reader what to say at a VCAT hearing ('You must say exactly this') and claims they are 'legally entitled to every cent'. Also implies an outcome and uses scary legal framing.
findings.fix: Remove the paragraph, or replace with calm general information such as 'The kit shows you how to gather your evidence if you and your rental provider disagree about your bond.'

findings.problem: 'If your rental provider tries to keep your bond' makes a claim about other people's behaviour, banned by voice.md section 4.
findings.fix: Reword neutrally or drop it with the paragraph.

findings.problem: Second link (Move-Out Kit). emails.md requires exactly one main link.
findings.fix: Remove line 14 and keep only the toolkit link on line 12.

findings.problem: Footer has no unsubscribe link or {{unsubscribe_url}} (Spam Act 2003).
findings.fix: Use the full footer from emails.md, including 'Unsubscribe: {{unsubscribe_url}}'.

findings.problem: Missing 'Fullbond provides general information, not legal advice.' line, though the email touches on bond and tenancy rights.
findings.fix: Add that line as the last footer line.

findings.problem: Footer is incomplete: no 'You're getting this because...' line, no ABN placeholder, no company address placeholder.
findings.fix: Replace with the exact three-line footer from .claude/rules/emails.md.
